programmes.amount_note: Almi does not publish loan amounts, interest rates or ceilings on its lending page; loans are priced individually and normally complement bank financing. No amount is recorded here rather than guessed.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous — lending, not a call. Applications are made through Almi's e-services at any time.

procedure_steps.detail: Prepare a business plan and financing need; Almi lending usually complements bank or own financing.
Log in to Almi's e-services with BankID, mobile BankID or Telia e-legitimation and complete the loan application.
Register the company before disbursement — 'Företaget behöver inte vara registrerat vid ansökningstillfället, men det måste vara registrerat innan utbetalning.'

documents_required.note: Requires BankID / mobile BankID / Telia e-legitimation

eligibility.other_note: 'Företaget behöver inte vara registrerat vid ansökningstillfället, men det måste vara registrerat innan utbetalning.' Almi is state-owned and lends on commercial terms, typically at a higher interest rate than banks to reflect risk (rate not published on the page).

programmes.source_snippet: Vi ger näring till Sverige genom att erbjuda finansiering i form av lån och riskkapital ... Företaget behöver inte vara registrerat vid ansökningstillfället, men det måste vara registrerat innan utbetalning.

programmes.amount_note: 'Maximalt 500 000 kr' per project, for testing customer needs and business viability. The support percentage is not stated on the call page, so none is recorded here.
programmes.deadline_note: The 2026 call opens 12 October 2026 and closes 12 January 2027 at 14:00. Vinnova runs this call annually.

procedure_steps.detail: Check that the company is a Swedish aktiebolag no more than 10 years old, with at most 10 employees and at most SEK 10 million net turnover.
Log in and complete the application in Vinnova's e-service, describing the project, the parties and the budget.
Submit before the closing time; Vinnova assesses and notifies the decision.

documents_required.doc: Application in Vinnova's e-service (project description, parties, budget)
Company registration certificate / evidence of company age, headcount and turnover

eligibility.other_note: 'Svenska aktiebolag som är högst 10 år gamla, har max 10 anställda, högst 10 mkr i nettoomsättning'. Vinnova grants of this type are commonly awarded as försumbart stöd (de minimis), but the call page text we read did not state it, so it is not asserted here.

programmes.source_snippet: Svenska aktiebolag som är högst 10 år gamla, har max 10 anställda, högst 10 mkr i nettoomsättning ... Maximalt 500 000 kr ... 12 okt. 2026 - 12 jan. 2027 kl 14:00.
